queries.text: Find a CSV dataset with hailstorm tracks, latitude and longitude, timestamps, and storm intensity.
Find school 5 time-series sensor data with PM2.5, NO2, O3, CO2, humidity, temperature, and sensor identifiers.
Find the Jan or January file-slice HDF5 atmospheric station data with ozone, nitrogen oxides, meteorological parameters, and rain variables.
Find time-series wind measurements with wind speed, wind direction, and wind shear exponent.
Find sensor time-series data with per-second particle counts from a field deployment.
Find a time series of still water level or tidal water level measurements.
Find the year1 or first-year time-series telemetry data for juvenile Greenland cod with hourly positions, latitude and longitude, cove labels, and transplant or control group information.
Find a table of African mammal food web site locations with site code, community name, country, latitude, and longitude.
Find a species trait table with mammal body mass in grams and binary or categorical feeding-resource traits such as vertebrate, bird, plant, or invertebrate consumption.
Find weather station data with dateTime, temperature, relative humidity, rainfall, wind speed, wind gust, wind direction, and barometric pressure.
